'''Minashee''' was an industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin subsector]]. It served as the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].
